dedupe_keys.name: webgis adbpo it landslide and ground movement hazard datasets

description: webgis.adbpo.it: landslide and ground movement hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by webgis.adbpo.it. Coverage: the area served by webgis.adbpo.it. The listing groups 17 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about landslide and ground movement hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Punti frana stabilizzata UoM Po 2001 (Distretto Po); Punti frana attiva UoM Po 2001 (Distretto Po); Punti frana quiescente UoM UoM Po 2001 (Distretto Po); Aree di versante in condizioni di dissesto UoM Marecchia-Conca Aree ve. Formats seen: WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
